alerts.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued October 25 at 3:08PM HST by NWS Honolulu HI
alerts.description:
ESFHFO

A significant pattern change is expected late Monday night through at
least Thursday as deep tropical moisture is brought north. A
combination of surface lows and troughs will bring exceptionally
moist air over the state beginning late Monday night. Heavy rain and
isolated thunderstorms are possible throughout this period. Models
have not converged on details yet, so exact locations, timing, and
rainfall amounts are not certain. Please be prepared for periods of
heavy rain this coming week.

Keep up to date with the latest forecast information through the
Internet (weather.gov/hawaii), local media, social media, or NOAA
Weather Radio broadcasts.

An updated outlook will be issued MOnday by 6 AM HST or sooner if
necessary.

alerts.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued October 25 at 4:13AM HST by NWS Honolulu HI
alerts.description:
ESFHFO

A significant pattern change is expected Monday night through at
least Thursday as deep tropical moisture is brought north. A
combination of surface lows and troughs will bring exceptionally
moist air over the eastern end of the state beginning Monday night
and extending to all islands Tuesday. Heavy rain and thunderstorms
are possible throughout this period. Models have not converged on
details yet, so exact locations, timing, and rainfall amounts are not
certain. Please be prepared for periods of heavy rain this coming
week.

Keep up to date with the latest forecast information through the
Internet (weather.gov/hawaii), local media, social media, or NOAA
Weather Radio broadcasts.

An updated outlook will be issued Sunday by 6 PM HST or sooner if
necessary.

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS Central Pacific Hurricane Center Honolulu HI
Issued by NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
800 PM HST Sun Oct 25 2026

For the central North Pacific...between 140W and 180W:

Active Systems:
The National Hurricane Center is issuing advisories on Tropical
Storm Vance, located a few hundred miles west-southwest of Acapulco,
Mexico, and on Tropical Storm Olana, located several hundred miles
west-southwest of Johnston Atoll.

Tropical cyclone formation is not expected during the next 7 days.

&&
Public Advisories on Tropical Storm Olana are issued under
WMO header WTPA33 KNHC and under AWIPS header HFOTCPCP3.
Forecast/Advisories on Tropical Storm Olana are issued under
WMO header WTPA23 KNHC and under AWIPS header HFOTCMCP3.

$$
Forecaster Kelly
